instruction_profiles_note: Hardware instruction sampling at a fixed period of 1,000,000 user instructions, including inherited threads and solver processes. Counts are estimates with partial periods omitted, not exact retired-instruction totals. Both profiles used cpu_core/instructions/u; no lost-sample warning was emitted.
limitations: Frozen Prusti a59ed917c client, adapter and Rust fixture; only Ferrum runtime changed. This is not a fresh matrix on the current stdlib branch.
Shared host with substantial timing variation. Two pairs establish no reliable end-to-end latency improvement.
Fresh service per request; request wall time starts after socket readiness and excludes service startup.
Native CPU is process user+system time; solver CPU is reaped child user+system time on untraced trials. Both vary with host clock speed and scheduling.
CPU profiles sampled only the server tree, excluding the client. Rust worker DWARF stacks failed to unwind, so native instruction-pointer samples were used for attribution. Z3 stacks were recovered.
Instruction sampling uses one run per binary; unchanged solver instruction count corroborates the change in native work, but does not establish a broad performance result.
43 opt-in Silicon unit tests were not run. Direct-Prusti correctness was checked on the selected cases only.
